definitionZh: 中风线盖 CSS 属性定义了在 SVG 元素的未闭合中风的开放子路径末端使用的形状. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The stroke-linecap CSS property defines the shape to be used at the end of open subpaths of SVG elements' unclosed strokes. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
